newsitem.title: USA: Media General to buy newspaper for $42 mln.
newsitem.headline: Media General to buy newspaper for $42 mln.

text.p: Media General Inc said it had reached an agreement in principle to acquire the assets of a California newspaper from Garden State Newspapers Inc for about $42 million.
The company said The Eureka Times Standard in Eureka, Calif. was an evening newspaper with a daily circulation of 22,000 and one of 24,000 on Sunday.
"The purchase will be cash flow positive from the start," it said.
The company said it expected to close the deal in the spring. Once it is done, Media General will operate 21 daily newspapers and nearly 100 weekly and periodical publications, it said.
The acquisition would provide the company with the tax advantages associated with the previous exchange of newspapers with Community Newspapers Holdings Inc, it added.
Media General has interests in newspapers, broadcast and cable television.
